name: policani/pmo-governance-operations-log
summary: 据发布者介绍，这份 AI 辅助的项目管理办公室日志可将运营动态整理为决策、待办事项、风险记录和需升级处理的问题，也可用于会前准备和跟踪后续事项的负责人。

The publisher describes an AI-assisted project management office log that helps turn operational updates into decisions, action items, risk records, and escalations. It also supports meeting preparation and tracking who owns each follow-up.
